roadmap.title: Tutorial and solo office activities
roadmap.description: Use the New Employee tutorial for Snake and MeowTube. Start the Minesweeper total there too. A lobby started alone also lets you work on emotes, camera updates and office objects. Visit Stanton for its reception chair.

roadmap.title: Cooperate on roles and shared tasks
roadmap.description: Arrange promotions, dismissals, phone calls and task-dependent actions with other players. Host the lobby for the Slacker Assistant win and four-Slacker firing streak. Use six players for the streak setup, including a Manager and a Specialist.

roadmap.title: Finish the cumulative counters
roadmap.description: Finish camera updates, beer drinking, Minesweeper wins, Specialist tasks, Slacker tasks and firefighting. Take these opportunities during earlier rounds so fewer remain at the end.

achievements.description: Fire another player
achievements.summary: Dismiss another employee while playing as Manager.

steps.text: As @mechanic{Manager}, fire an employee during a meeting.

achievements.description: Complete all your tasks
achievements.summary: Finish one complete set of three assigned tasks.

steps.text: As a @mechanic{Specialist} or @mechanic{Slacker}, finish the three tasks in your current assignment.

achievements.description: Get fired
achievements.summary: Be dismissed from your job by the Manager.

steps.text: Ask the @mechanic{Manager} to fire you at a meeting.

achievements.description: Get promoted to the assistant
achievements.summary: Receive a promotion to Assistant.

steps.text: Ask the @mechanic{Manager} to appoint you as @mechanic{Assistant}.

achievements.description: Become the janitor
achievements.summary: Take the Janitor role after being fired.

steps.text: Use a lobby with a @mechanic{Janitor} slot enabled. Arrange to be the first employee fired so you become the Janitor.

achievements.description: Receive a phone call
achievements.summary: Receive an incoming call on your desk phone.

steps.text: Have a coworker call your desk phone, then answer the incoming call.

achievements.description: Win a game as a slacker
achievements.summary: Finish a round on the winning Slacker team.

steps.text: As a @mechanic{Slacker}, complete slacking tasks to lower productivity and help your team win. Hide your role to avoid being fired.

achievements.description: Infect manager's computer
achievements.summary: Put a virus on the Manager's computer.

steps.text: As a @mechanic{Slacker}, wait for @mechanic{Malware Mischief} and create an @item{infected floppy disk} for that task.
Use the infected disk on the computer in the @loc{Manager's office}.

achievements.description: Take 5 shit in the same game
achievements.summary: Defecate five times before a single round ends.

steps.text: Use a toilet to defecate five times in the same round; the five uses can be consecutive.

achievements.description: Update the firmware of 100 cameras
achievements.summary: Perform 100 camera firmware updates in total.

steps.text: Approach a camera and hold @mechanic{F} to update its firmware. Update cameras until your total reaches 100; a camera becomes available again after 30 seconds.

achievements.description: Update a camera whilst the CCTV is in use
achievements.summary: Update a camera while CCTV is being watched.

steps.text: Start @mechanic{CCTV} on the computer in the @loc{Manager's office}.
Leave CCTV running and update a camera with a red indicator by holding @mechanic{F} beside it.

achievements.description: Drink 100 beers
achievements.summary: Consume a total of 100 beers.

steps.text: Drink beer from the @loc{kitchen} fridge and bin the empty bottles to keep the supply available. Reach 100 drinks across your games.

achievements.description: Enable servers after disabling them
achievements.summary: Restore the servers after shutting them down yourself.

steps.text: As a @mechanic{Slacker}, wait for @mechanic{Bandwidth Bandit} and switch off the servers for that task.
At the @loc{server room} equipment, hold @mechanic{F} and choose the action to turn the servers back on.

achievements.description: Win 100 Minesweeper games
achievements.summary: Accumulate 100 victories in Minesweeper.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Minesweeper} on your PC in the @mechanic{New Employee} tutorial.
Left-click safe squares and right-click suspected mines to flag them. Each number shows how many mines touch that square; reveal every safe square to win.
Start another board and keep winning until you reach 100 victories in total.

achievements.description: Get a score over 60 at Snake
achievements.summary: Reach a score of at least 61 in a single Snake game.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Snake} on your PC in the @mechanic{New Employee} tutorial.
Steer with @mechanic{WASD} to collect red dots without touching the boundary or your own body. Use wide loops as the snake grows, and reach 61 points.

achievements.description: Fire your own assistant
achievements.summary: Dismiss the employee serving as your Assistant.

steps.text: As @mechanic{Manager}, promote an employee to @mechanic{Assistant}, then fire that employee at a meeting.

achievements.description: Win as a Slacker Assistant
achievements.summary: Win for the Slacker team while serving as Assistant.

steps.text: Host the lobby and play as a @mechanic{Slacker}. Ask the Manager to promote you to @mechanic{Assistant}.
Help the Slackers win while you still hold the Assistant position.

achievements.description: Place 15 sticky notes in one game
achievements.summary: Make 15 sticky-note placements during one round.

steps.text: Place a @item{sticky note}, pick the note back up, and attach it again until you have made 15 placements in that round.

achievements.description: As a manager fire 4 slackers in a row
achievements.summary: Dismiss four Slackers consecutively as Manager.

steps.text: Host a lobby with at least six players: yourself as @mechanic{Manager}, one Specialist, and four Slackers.
Fire each of the four Slackers without firing a Specialist between them.

achievements.description: Drink a beer, smoke a cigarette, and drink coffee all within a minute
achievements.summary: Consume beer, coffee and a cigarette puff within 60 seconds.

steps.text: Bring a @item{coffee mug} and @item{cigarettes} to the @loc{kitchen}. Fill the mug with coffee and have a beer from the fridge ready.
Take a cigarette puff, drink the coffee and drink the beer before 60 seconds have passed from your first consumption.

achievements.description: As a janitor, get promoted to assistant
achievements.summary: Receive an Assistant promotion while working as Janitor.

steps.text: After becoming @mechanic{Janitor}, ask the Manager to promote you to @mechanic{Assistant}.

achievements.description: Refill the toilet paper whilst a player is taking a dump
achievements.summary: Replace toilet paper while another player is defecating.

steps.text: Coordinate with a player who has a toilet task while you have the paper-refill task.
Refill the toilet paper during that player's toilet use. If the refill is unavailable until the player finishes, refill immediately afterward.

achievements.description: Turn ON another players antivirus that had been turned OFF
achievements.summary: Switch a coworker's disabled antivirus back on.

steps.text: Have a coworker disable the antivirus on their PC, then use that PC to enable the antivirus again.

achievements.description: Place a sticky Note on the back of the manager
achievements.summary: Attach a sticky note to the Manager's back.

steps.text: Carry a @item{sticky note} behind the Manager and hold @mechanic{F} to attach the note to their back; writing on the note is optional.

achievements.description: Smoke 100 cigarettes
achievements.summary: Take 100 cigarette puffs in total.

steps.text: Take 100 puffs from a @item{cigarette}; you can keep using the same cigarette.

achievements.description: Dance for 3 min straight in one game
achievements.summary: Keep dancing for three uninterrupted minutes in one round.

steps.text: Hold @mechanic{G}, select the dance emote and leave the dance running for three minutes without pressing anything that interrupts it.

achievements.description: Achieve a total of 500 tasks as a Specialist
achievements.summary: Complete a total of 500 Specialist tasks.

guide.context: The task total carries between rounds.

steps.text: Complete blue @mechanic{Specialist tasks} until your running total reaches 500.

achievements.description: Email the manager from another players PC
achievements.summary: Send the Manager an email using another employee's computer.

steps.text: Use a coworker's PC to compose an email. Select the current Manager's name as the recipient and send the message.

achievements.description: Achieve a total of 500 tasks as a Slacker
achievements.summary: Complete a total of 500 slacking or sabotage tasks.

guide.context: Progress carries between rounds. Shared red slacking tasks also count when you complete them as a Specialist.

steps.text: As a @mechanic{Slacker}, complete assigned slacking and sabotage tasks until you reach 500 task credits.

achievements.description: Get fired as Manager
achievements.summary: Lose your job while holding the Manager role.

steps.text: Play as @mechanic{Manager} in a lobby with at least four players. Let the deadline for firing an employee expire without dismissing anyone.

achievements.description: Drink coffee out of your Boss mug without being the Boss
achievements.summary: Drink coffee from the Manager's mug while you are not Manager.

steps.text: While playing a role other than Manager, take the @item{Manager's mug} from their office. Fill the mug with coffee in the @loc{kitchen} and drink from it.

achievements.description: Jelly another players stapler on the Stanton map
achievements.summary: Coat another employee's stapler with jelly on Stanton.

steps.text: On @loc{Stanton}, take @item{jelly} from the kitchen cupboard and use the jelly on a coworker's stapler.

achievements.description: Hang a drawing on the display board
achievements.summary: Pin a printed drawing to the office display board.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{paint} from your PC's Start menu, make a drawing and print the picture.
Collect your drawing from the printer and pin the sheet to the @loc{display board}.

achievements.description: Extinguish 50 Fires
achievements.summary: Put out 50 fires in total.

steps.text: For more fire opportunities in a cooperative lobby, ask the host to keep @mechanic{The Fire Guy} enabled and disable some other Slacker tasks.
Use a @item{fire extinguisher} whenever a Slacker starts a fire, until you have extinguished 50 across your games.

achievements.description: Be demoted from assistant
achievements.summary: Have your Assistant position taken away.

steps.text: After becoming @mechanic{Assistant}, ask the Manager to demote you.

achievements.description: Sit in the secretary's  seat on the Stanton map
achievements.summary: Sit in the receptionist chair on Stanton.

steps.text: On @loc{Stanton}, sit in the secretary's chair at reception beside the Manager's office.

achievements.description: Perform a private greeting for the kitchen camera.
achievements.summary: Wave at the kitchen camera while alone in the kitchen with music playing.

steps.text: In the @loc{kitchen}, put a CD in the @item{boombox} and start the music.
Update the kitchen camera's firmware if its indicator is not blinking green.
When nobody else is in the kitchen, face the camera, hold @mechanic{G} and select the wave emote.

achievements.description: Spend ten minutes watching MeowTube.
achievements.summary: Watch MeowTube for ten consecutive minutes.

steps.text: In the @mechanic{New Employee} tutorial, open @mechanic{MeowTube} on your PC and stay seated watching for ten minutes.
